info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Miles-v4-spec
info.description: The Airline Flights Miles Retrieval API enables users to efficiently access and retrieve mileage information for various airline flights. This API serves as a resource for businesses and applications that require data on flight miles, helping users to assess travel options and loyalty rewards. Typical consumers include travel agencies, travel planners, and airline loyalty program managers who need quick access to comprehensive flight mileage data. With this endpoint, developers can integrate mileage information into their applications, enhancing user experience and facilitating informed decision-making.

get.description: This API endpoint allows users to retrieve the mileage information associated with flights. Users can use this information for various purposes such as loyalty programs or trip planning.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters needed to fetch flight mile details. It must contain valid JSON data that adheres to the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieves the mileage data for flights.
